claim.value: Acquisition mix can shift apparent retention.
claim.scope: A possible influence on observed retention; its magnitude and direction are unspecified.

provenance.rationale: P026 explicitly identifies acquisition mix as a condition that can shift apparent retention.

signal_basis.value: Observe concentrations of onboarding trajectories by milestone position, waiting time, returns to active work and time to publication; record acquisition mix and compare like observation windows.
signal_basis.scope: Observed cohort retention patterns, without an estimated acquisition-mix effect.

provenance.rationale: P014 supplies the trajectory measurements; P026 supplies acquisition mix and the requirement to compare like observation windows.
No conditional empirical warrant is needed for this bounded possibility claim.

rationale: Changing the composition of a cohort can change its aggregate retention pattern when constituent accounts have different onboarding trajectories. This licenses acquisition mix as a possible influence on apparent retention. The claim does not assert that acquisition mix actually produced any observed difference or specify an effect size.
uncertainty: The observations do not establish whether acquisition mix affected this cohort, or the magnitude or direction of any effect; those questions fall outside the claim.
